data.body: **P2 — Implement the advertised handler context scope.** This marker only permits the core to look up `handler_context`, but this class defines no such method. If a later invocation-start hook binds an absent or unrelated span, that binding is copied into the worker and top-level user spans/logs leave the Workflow trace, making tracing depend on plugin order. Add a scope analogous to `InvocationOtelPlugin.handler_context` that rebinds `_workflow_span` when the ambient trace is absent or unrelated, with tests covering a span-binding plugin in both orders.
